features.name: Login & per-user data isolation
features.notes: Scrypt-hashed passwords + session tokens; every account sees only its own patients, medicines, alerts and cameras

features.name: Dashboard (live vitals)
features.notes: Responsive web app, live refresh every 2 seconds, Safe / Caution / Danger badges

features.name: Medication manager
features.notes: Add schedule, mark taken, adherence log persisted to disk

features.name: AI danger-score rules engine
features.notes: Transparent clinical thresholds for heart rate, SpO2, BP, temperature, glucose

features.name: Alert generation + escalation workflow
features.notes: Instant danger alerts with de-dupe cooldown and a full escalation log

features.name: Emergency auto-call chain
features.notes: Danger alert triggers an immediate call chain: family -> backup contact -> emergency services 108/112 (ambulance dispatch with GPS + vitals). Placement is SIMULATED (telecom API in production); the trigger/retry/escalation logic is real

features.name: Hospital Virtual Ward view
features.notes: Nurse-station bed list with live vitals and HIGH / MEDIUM / NORMAL priority queue

features.name: Privacy-first camera zones
features.notes: Fall / out-of-bed / low-activity event feed; on-device AI, NO video recorded or stored

features.name: Live camera preview for family
features.notes: Privacy-safe real-time view of a camera zone (privacy-safe metadata feed rendered on canvas)

features.name: Multilingual UI
features.notes: English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu — including patient names

features.name: Vital-sign data (patient readings)
features.notes: Simulation engine with per-condition profiles and danger episodes (real hardware is the roadmap)

features.name: Camera event data
features.notes: Event generator drives the fall / out-of-bed / low-activity alerts

features.name: SMS / WhatsApp / email / phone-call delivery
features.notes: Delivery endpoints are stubbed here; live APIs (telecom, WhatsApp) in production
